caveats: skill2: Gentle Current (charge time fixed at 1 sec vs non-stage-target Raptures) is not modeled — the solo-raid boss is always the stage target, so Raging Current is permanently active and Gentle Current can never fire.

skill2: her Charge Speed immunity is enforced engine-side via charFixes.statImmunities ['chargeSpeedPct'] — the stat is stripped from any incoming KIT buff at application time, so no teammate grant (or debuff) can move her charge frames. Three documented scope limits: it covers the chargeSpeedPct stat only (a 'charge time is fixed at X sec' effect, chargeTimeClamp, is a different primitive and is not covered); it covers kit `buff` effects only, so cube (adjutant/quantum) and Overload (chargespd) Charge Speed still reach her — inert on the scope-lock basis (no cube, OL0) but live in the web app, and whether a kit immunity suppresses the holder's own gear is unruled; and target SELECTION is unchanged (she still occupies a selector slot, which is what lets maxwell's bundled ATK reach her).

burst: the 925% additional-damage nuke carries burstDesc:'allEnemies' (its kit line sits under '■ Affects all enemies.') — it reads the trina-family burstSkillAoeDamagePct amp when cast inside an amp window; no amp in the comp = byte-identical.
